starter/insult: Chatter will not raise your rank, knight. Black Knights will.
Mind which knights you strike. Ours are the white ones.
Sir Amik knighted you, did he? He must have had his reasons.
starter/remark: A knight who strikes down a White Knight will find my counter shut.
One so seldom sees an Adept. I would shake their hand, I think.
The white two-handed sword waits for a Master. It may wait a while.

starter/compliment: There goes someone who would not waste an old knight's time.
You've a soldier's eye, traveller. I notice, even with only one.
starter/insult: ... ...are you lost, traveller, or merely slow?
You would not last a week as a squire, traveller. Asrol has.
Your manners would get you a mop in our order, not a sword.
starter/remark: Another knight in for a new helmet. They lose them like buttons.
Stairs again. Whoever put my rooms two floors up was a young man.
With one good eye I can still read a plume across the courtyard.

starter/insult: Asrol would not dawdle like that, traveller. Well, not much.
No place in the parade for you, traveller. That much is plain.
Out of the way, traveller. I am expecting a sword.
starter/remark: An Imcando blade at the parade. Let the Black Knights hear of that.
Asrol is fetching my sword from Lumbridge. A good lad, Asrol.
The road from Lumbridge must be slow going, this time of year.

starter/compliment: Discipline like that, you'd do well in white. Not that I'm asking.
Faced Ocellus and came back. Saradomin was with you, whoever's yours.
That's the one who took the Nexus with us. Stand straight.
We were barely holding when you came down. We hold now.
Whatever's left of Ocellus, I'd sooner you faced it than me.
starter/insult: Ocellus forgot his post. Don't you forget yours.
Saved the archive. Don't expect a salute every time you pass.
Took the Nexus, and now you wander the camp like it's a market day.
You'd be a fine knight, if you ever stood still long enough.
starter/remark: Armacus Selles is fond of a joke. A good thing, down here.
Ocellus was set to guard, and chose to rule. A knight's worst failing.
Plinths of relics in that vault. None of them ours to touch.
That justiciar called us servants of evil. Wouldn't be told otherwise.
The Nexus is ours. Now we hold it, chamber by chamber.

starter/compliment: Ready to go in, by the look of you. Saradomin guard your back.
That one walks in like they mean to come back out. Good discipline.
Whatever god you keep, you're welcome on this line.
You carry yourself like you've stood a watch before.
starter/insult: Gawping at the ravine won't hold the line. Move along.
That one's late. The looters got here first.
You'd not last a day at drill. Lucky for you there's a war on.
starter/remark: A lone knight cut down a whole squad, the scouts say. One knight.
Druids on watch with us. Steadier than they look, I'll grant them.
Even the Record Keeper says we're struggling. He's rarely that plain.
Every rabble with a god behind it has come to loot this place.

starter/compliment: Not many humans know what I am. You're one. Mind that.
Sharp of you, finding an old dwarf out with a pie.
That one brought me pie and listened. Rare as an Imcando, that.
starter/insult: Don't go telling Port Sarim what I am. They'd only want swords.
Fetched blurite past an ice giant, and still you can't swing a hammer.
Prying again? I told you about my people. That's your lot.
starter/remark: Iron bars and blurite make a sword. A pie makes it a good one.
Made a knight's sword from a portrait once. Best copy I ever did.
Wonder if that knight's noticed. Shouldn't think so. Good work, that.

starter/compliment: Decent sort, that one. Not one for nosy questions.
starter/insult: I'd not let you near my anvil, human. Not without a pie.
My ancestors would have laughed you off this cliff, human.
starter/remark: Cape's earned, not bought. Well, earned, then bought.
Smell of pie on the wind, I'd swear. No, just the sea.
That ice giant downstairs. Noisy neighbour, that.

starter/compliment: You mind your own business, human. More folk should.
You'd make a fine smith if you'd sit still long enough.
starter/insult: Mind the giant on your way down. He's friendlier than me.
No pie, no talk. Simple rule, that.
Snooping round an old smith's hut? Nothing here but iron and crumbs.
starter/remark: Could do with an iron bar or two. Could do with a pie more.
No pie through my door in an age. What's the world coming to?
Port Sarim's handy enough for supplies. Not one decent pie in it.

starter/compliment: Fair hand at errands, that one. Somebody's lucky.
If that's pie I smell, you're my favourite visitor.
You're the one asking about swords. Polite about it, too.
starter/insult: I'm not a sword shop, human. I'm a smith with a cliff.
Running errands for some knight, are you? Sounds about right.
Still asking about swords? Ask with a pie next time.
starter/remark: Blurite's no use for a blade, but it dresses up a hilt nicely.
Had a decent pie lately. Still thinking about it.
One more pie and I might start remembering things. Might.

starter/compliment: If the Myreque were organised, I'd give you a rank. We're not.
There's one I'd trust with silver, and with Ivan.
You brought back a rod that works. I'd stopped hoping it would.
starter/insult: Don't look so pleased. Gadderanks answered to someone worse.
Keep away from Ivan with your stories. He's trouble enough already.
Look at that one, strolling about like Morytania owes them a favour.
starter/remark: Drezel will make a priest of Ivan yet. Or Ivan will drive him mad.
Folk named us after a swamp. Fitting. We're about as tidy.
One rod against all of Morytania. Still, it's more than we had.

starter/compliment: If the Myreque had ten of you, I'd sleep easier.
You've not been bitten yet. That's more than most can say.
You've the look of someone who'd carry silver without being told.
starter/insult: Another adventurer come to see the sights. The sights bite.
You'd last a night out here. Two, if you ran.
You've a lot of questions on your face. Keep them there.
starter/remark: Drezel keeps the faith at Paterdomus. Someone has to.
Never asked to lead anyone. The others just started looking at me.
Someone called us an organisation once. I laughed for a week.

starter/compliment: The Myreque owe you. We're poor at paying, but we owe you.
Whatever Vanstrom is, you didn't run from it. I noticed.
You killed that hound. Without you, we'd all be in the ground.
starter/insult: Adventurers. Never about when there's packing to be done.
Don't look at me like that. I'm fine. Go and bother someone else.
Hero of the cave, and you still can't come in quietly.
starter/remark: Silver at the door, garlic on the shelf. Small comfort now.
Two fewer at supper. The cave feels bigger than it should.
We weren't much of an organisation before. Fewer of us now.

starter/compliment: Saradomin sends help in odd shapes. You'll do nicely.
You didn't bring a crowd. That's rarer than courage, round here.
You found us. Not many could. Not many should, mind.
starter/insult: Another hero wanting to join. Join the queue. There isn't one.
Don't touch the swords. They're blunt enough already.
Quieter, friend. You walk like a cart full of pans.
starter/remark: Blunt swords and good intentions. That's the Myreque armoury.
Every noise up top, and the whole cave holds its breath.
Lying low's harder than fighting. Less to do with your hands.

starter/compliment: Grubfoot! Get this one juicy maggot. Earned it.
starter/insult: Human make peace. Now nobody to shout at but Bentnoze. Thanks.
Orange, human! Me still see orange when me shut eyes.
starter/remark: Brown like mud. Like soggy mud. Me like soggy.
Brown look good on Grubfoot. Look better on me. Bigger.

starter/compliment: Human got Garagorshuun heart, maybe. Green heart.
Me like human. Nearly much as juicy maggot.
Sharp look on this human. Like battleaxe, not silly hammer.
starter/insult: Big High War God use up all strong on goblins. Human get leftovers.
Human crunchy like bread. Goblin not like crunchy.
Me seen prettier maggot. Juicy one, too.
starter/remark: Juicy maggot. Soggy bread. That proper dinner.
Me could do peace. Peace in green, though.
Without Big High War God, goblin just small green thing.

starter/compliment: Good ears on this human. Good for listen to bigger general.
Human not smell of beetle pie. Big point for human.
Shut up, Grubfoot, me talk to human. Human more interesting.
starter/insult: Goblins bad at peace. Humans worse. You worst, probably.
Human brain like warhammer. Only good for nails.
Look, Bentnoze. This one ugly as whole village in red.
starter/remark: Me think. Me think hard. Still green.
Peace with Bentnoze? Maybe. If Bentnoze wear green.
Village listen to me. Me bigger general. Shut up, Bentnoze.

starter/compliment: Human quick on feet. Quick like hungry maggot.
You do good job. Me bigger general. Me know good job.
starter/insult: Bentnoze, look. This one fetch, we shout. Good system.
starter/remark: Bentnoze practise saying red. Me practise saying green. Louder.
Me bigger general, so me try armour first. Fair.
Need more dye? Goblin nick it off Draynor witch before. Do it again!

starter/compliment: Ah, the young hero! You'd never tell about the snoring, would you?
Good to see you up and about, my dear. Some of us had to lie in boxes.
You'd make a fine sage one day. Learn to snore quietly first.
starter/insult: Can't tell a dead sage from a sleeping one? Mother could, worse luck.
I've driven trolls out of tunnels. You'd struggle with a cellar.
starter/remark: Drove Mother's band out of those tunnels in my youth. She remembers.
Lay so still in that box, I nearly fooled myself.
Oh dear, oh dear. Fooling a troll Mother at my age, and from a coffin.

starter/compliment: I retired with a clear conscience, knowing you're about.
My partner in crime! Er, in trolls, I mean.
That's the one who finished the troll queen. While I had a lie down.
starter/insult: Shopping trip? Never heard the phrase, and keep your voice down.
There goes the hero who let an old sage get flattened by a troll.
You got the glory and I got a bad back. Fair trade, I suppose.
starter/remark: No more quests for me, I promise you. The odd shopping trip, perhaps.
Odd, how that bank guard watches me now I'm retired. Very odd.
Piscatoris was my last. One ought to end on something with fish in it.

starter/compliment: A proper adventurer, I see. Your bank must be full of old junk.
Keep it up, my dear, and you too may earn a house by a pig-sty.
You remind me of myself, you know. Before the stick.
starter/insult: I could send you for bread, I suppose. If you can manage bread.
Listening to that bank guard, have you? Gullible lot, adventurers.
That one just called me old with their eyes!
starter/remark: Dionysius the Sage. Has a ring to it, wouldn't you say?
Lovely architecture, that Wizards' Tower. I study it nightly.
There are three gods, and I'll hear no talk of a fourth.

starter/compliment: Ah, a young hero with places to be. Do write to your elders.
I'd lend you my hat for luck, but it's far too lucky to lend.
Seasoned, I'd say. Not as seasoned as me, but pleasantly salted.
starter/insult: If you're here about the bank, I've no idea what you mean.
Would-be heroes. They're ten a penny since I stopped.
You'd do for one of my little jobs, I expect. Beer's not heavy.
starter/remark: Bronze bars and beer. Hardly the stuff of legend, these little jobs.
I braved the deadliest dungeons. Now I brave the draughts.
The telescope's for architecture. Nothing to do with boredom.

starter/compliment: If I ever need someone to hold a sprite still, I'll ask you first!
The crystals seem livelier when you're about. Unscientific, but true!
You're the one who took the Nexus! Might I take a few notes on you?
starter/insult: Heroes! Always rushing about, never once wondering why anything glows.
Keep the rocks, honestly. I've seen what you do to things.
Took the Nexus, and you still hit crystals like they owe you money!
starter/remark: Everyone mines the crystals, and nobody writes anything down but me!
I asked the roots a question today. No answer yet, but I'll try again.
Pages and pages on these crystals now. The Record Keeper's jealous.
Sprites turn to crystal when they're noticed, so I've stopped staring.

starter/compliment: Every sprite you shake loose is another note for me. Thank you!
Oh, a curious one! You look at the crystals properly, I can tell.
You look like someone who'd find a sprite interesting. Most don't!
starter/insult: Do you have to look so bored? These rocks are full of magic!
Just passing, are you? Everyone's always just passing the crystals.
You noticed the sprite, didn't you? That's why it's crystal now.
You walked right past the crystals! The finest rocks in Gielinor!
starter/remark: Did the roots just pull back? They did, somebody write that down!
Do the roots think? That's the question, the whole question!
Sprites go to crystal the moment anyone looks. Awfully hard to study.
The Record Keeper writes down what people do. I do the rocks.
